description: A Python class 'RutgerBakt' that extends 'AbstractScraper' to scrape recipe data from 'rutgerbakt.nl', including methods for extracting title, author, category, ingredients, instructions, and description.

classes.name: RutgerBakt
classes.description: A scraper class for recipes from rutgerbakt.nl, providing methods to extract recipe details.

methods.name: author
methods.description: Returns the author name 'Rutger van den Broek'.

methods.name: title
methods.description: Extracts and cleans the recipe title from the schema.

methods.name: category
methods.description: Extracts the recipe category from the footer breadcrumb.

methods.name: yields
methods.description: Returns None as yields are not parsed.

methods.name: ingredient_groups
methods.description: Returns grouped ingredients using external 'group_ingredients' utility.

methods.name: instructions
methods.description: Extracts cooking instructions by locating the relevant heading and parsing subsequent elements.

methods.name: description
methods.description: Returns the first paragraph text as the recipe description.
